text:
amelia: Heads-up — cloned the new Next starter (LangChain adapters) and ran into two issues: missing telemetry events for agent.run and intermittent 401s after token rotation. Anyone else?
raj: Yep I hit this too. Steps: yarn, next dev, set RW_KEY, call /api/agent -> no telemetry shown in the dev console.
sofia: I think this is related to the modular agent adapter change last sprint. The JS path might not be wiring telemetry middleware.
mike: Repro here. Also seeing 401 bursts immediately after the console rotates the token; SDK retries but it causes user-visible failures. Log: "ERR 401 token expired" then repeated backoff retries.
amelia: Starter's pages/api/agent.ts does `const client = new RedwoodClient({ key: process.env.RW_KEY })` at module scope. If token rotates, that instance keeps the old key.
raj: For telemetry: found that modular adapter never calls telemetry.trackEvent in the agent.run path. Opening a tiny PR to add the hook and a unit test.
sofia: I'll own token propagation fix — change fetch adapter to use a token provider callback instead of capturing env on init. Adding unit + integration tests in the eval harness to simulate rotation.
ci-bot: created issue DE-487: "next starter: modular agent telemetry missing + stale token after rotation" assigned @raj @sofia.
mike: Temp workaround for devs: instantiate RedwoodClient per-request in Next API handler so it picks up current RW_KEY. Add a README note linking DE-487.
amelia: Good idea. Also add opt-in telemetry env RW_TELEMETRY_OPT_IN and document privacy.
raj: PR #1290 opened: telemetry hook added, test ensures telemetry.trackEvent called for agent.run.
sofia: WIP branch for token adapter: switching to tokenProvider func and adding e2e that posts rotate-token then calls agent endpoint expecting no 401. Will run GH actions on node 18/20 matrix.
mike: Once merged, cherry-pick to release branch and update quickstart template in onboarding so new users get the fix.
amelia: Thanks team. I'll update the starter README with the workaround and link to the issue. Closing once both PRs are merged.
